label: Eczema flare-up
note:
The patient presented with itchy, sore skin on the chest, hands, and arms. The patient reported a history of eczema and confirmed no current regular medications or allergies.

Examination revealed dry, cracked skin with no bleeding or discharge.

A flare-up of eczema was suspected. The patient was prescribed stronger steroid cream and emollients. Antihistamines were suggested for itch relief. A follow-up appointment was arranged for next week if symptoms did not improve.
patient:
Your appointment today
You came because your skin itched and hurt. You said you have eczema but take no medicine now. We saw your dry and cracked skin on your chest, hands and arms.

Your diagnosis
We suspect you have a flare-up of eczema. This means your eczema has become worse again recently.

Your treatment and next steps
Take stronger steroid cream on your affected skin. Use emollients to keep your skin soft and moist. Take antihistamines if you need help stopping the itch. Come back next week if your symptoms do not improve.

When to contact us
Call us if your skin does not get better soon.
summary: A patient in their thirties presented with intensely itchy, cracked skin on the chest, hands, and arms. Examination confirmed a rash consistent with previous eczema. A diagnosis of eczema flare-up was made, and treatment with stronger topical steroids, emollients, and antihistamines was prescribed.

answers.happened: The call quality was poor throughout and I said so, but pressed on. The patient had already tried a pharmacy steroid and an antihistamine and wanted something that worked quickly. The rash had spread beyond the sites of previous flares, which I noted but could not examine properly over that connection.
answers.learned: When the line is bad the examination is the part that suffers, and the examination was the part that mattered for a rash in new places. Asking what had already been tried saved prescribing the same thing again.
answers.next: Offer a video re-call or an in-person review when the connection is this poor, rather than treating on a partial view. I would also fix the review date at the end instead of leaving it as come back if not better.
